summary: The customer called for assistance setting up a newly purchased Apex Home Mesh Wi-Fi system, specifically encountering a blinking orange light on the main router. The agent guided the customer through power-cycling the modem and router, checking connection statuses, and using the mobile app to complete the setup. The router successfully achieved a solid white light, and the customer was able to finish configuring the network.

evidence.text: Thank you for calling Apex Telecom, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent maintained an extremely professional, polite, and helpful tone throughout the entire call.

evidence.text: I am so glad to hear that. Now, regarding the two satellite nodes, the app should guide you on where to place them next to expand your coverage.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent was encouraging, validating the customer's progress and showing genuine enthusiasm for resolving the issue.

evidence.text: It just turned solid white! That was much easier once we power-cycled the modem.

evidence.text: Yes, please unplug the power cable from both your modem and the new Apex router. Wait about thirty seconds, and then plug just the modem back in first.

evidence.text: You are very welcome! Enjoy your new Wi-Fi system, and have a wonderful rest of your day.

rubric_scores.justification: The agent properly confirmed that no further help was needed and closed the call with a warm, professional sign-off.

evidence.text: Blinking white is actually a great sign! That means it is booting up and searching for firmware updates.
